issue.title: Investigate usage of `utils` functions from Airflow core in Providers

repository.name: airflow
repository.description: Apache Airflow - A platform to programmatically author, schedule, and monitor workflows

issue.body:
Provider's have a lot of references of `utils` imports in them. Investigate that and remove those to remove `airflow-core` dependency on providers, this can be done either by:

1. If the util function is small-ish, consider moving it inside as a private function / class in provider itself while handling compat
2. If it can be consumed from task-sdk (if present in sdk), do that

issue.title: Use Task SDK TaskInstanceState in OpenSearch log handler

repository.name: airflow
repository.description: Apache Airflow - A platform to programmatically author, schedule, and monitor workflows

issue.body:
Replace the `airflow.utils.state` import with `airflow.sdk` in the OpenSearch task log
handler, so the provider relies on the Task SDK instead of `airflow-core`.

`airflow.sdk.TaskInstanceState` and `airflow.utils.state.TaskInstanceState` are two
independently defined `(str, Enum)` classes with matching member names and string values,
so this is a like-for-like import swap with no behaviour change. The provider requires
`apache-airflow>=3.0.0`, so `airflow.sdk` is always available and no version guard is
needed here, unlike providers that still support Airflow 2.11+.

Existing unit tests pass unmodified.

closes: #72409
